"""Targeted semantic cases: equal-depth BMP, cross-forest BMP, forest priority."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *
import imgtool
from collections import Counter

fails = 0
def T(name, fib, queries, expect_bmp=None):
    global fails
    ok, img = check_fib(name, fib, queries, verbose=False)
    if not ok:
        fails += 1; return None
    # report BMP fields found
    nodes = imgtool.find_nodes(img)
    print('   ', name, 'types', dict(Counter(n['type'] for n in nodes)),
          'cells', sum(img['cells']), 'rows', sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']))
    return img

A = 0x20010db8000000000000000000000000
# equal-depth prefix: /16 in G0 and its own G16 tree root BMP
fib = [(ref.mask(A, 16), 16, 5), (ref.mask(A | (0xdb8 << 112), 32), 32, 7)]
q = [A, A | (0xdb8 << 112), A | (0xdb8 << 112) | 1, A | (0xdead << 112), 0x3000 << 112, 0]
T('equal-depth-16', fib, q)

# equal-depth at a deeper node (relative length 6 -> l=0 at depth 22)
fib = [(ref.mask(A, 22), 22, 7), (ref.mask(A | 1, 40), 40, 8), (ref.mask(A | 2, 40), 40, 9),
       (ref.mask(A | 3, 40), 40, 10)]
T('equal-depth-22', fib, [A, A | 1, A | 2, A | 3, A | 4, A | (1 << 100)])

# cross-forest BMP: /0 (G0), /32 (G16), /64 (G16), /80 (G64)
fib = [(0, 0, 1), (ref.mask(A, 32), 32, 7), (ref.mask(A, 64), 64, 8), (ref.mask(A | 1, 80), 80, 9)]
q = [A, A | 1, A | 2, A | (0xffff << 112), 0x3000 << 112, 0, (1 << 128) - 1]
T('cross-forest-bmp', fib, q)

# forest priority: front64 present but only shorter prefixes match
K = A >> 64
fib = [(ref.mask(A, 16), 16, 5), (ref.mask(A, 64), 64, 8),
       (ref.mask((K << 64) | 0x1234, 80), 80, 9)]
q = [(K << 64) | 0x1234, (K << 64) | 0x9999, A, (0xbeef << 112)]
T('priority-64', fib, q)

# only G64 prefixes: root must be null, front16 empty
fib = [(ref.mask((K << 64) | i, 80), 80, 100 + i) for i in range(3)]
img = T('only-g64', fib, [(K << 64), (K << 64) | 5, A, 0])
assert img['root'] is None and img['front16'] == [], (img['root'], img['front16'])
assert len(img['front64']) == 1

# only G16 prefixes: root null, front64 empty
fib = [(ref.mask(A | (i << 100), 32 + i), 32 + i, 200 + i) for i in range(4)]
img = T('only-g16', fib, [A, A | (3 << 100), 0, (1 << 128) - 1])
assert img['root'] is None and img['front64'] == []
assert len(img['front16']) == 1

# only G0 prefixes
fib = [(ref.mask(A, L), L, 300 + L) for L in (0, 3, 6, 12, 16)]
img = T('only-g0', fib, [A, A | 1, 0, (1 << 128) - 1])
assert img['front16'] == [] and img['front64'] == [] and img['root'] is not None

# hop 0 and max hop
fib = [(ref.mask(A, 32), 32, 0), (ref.mask(A | (1 << 100), 100), 100, 4194302)]
T('hop-bounds', fib, [A, A | (1 << 100), A | (2 << 100)])
print('FAILS', fails)
